featuresPage.title: Platform features
featuresPage.desc: One platform for the whole teaching cycle from the first lesson to published grades.

features.title: Lessons prepared with AI
features.desc: The teacher writes a topic and the platform prepares a full lesson or an exam with its questions and answers within seconds. The teacher can edit it before publishing.

features.title: Exam monitoring
features.desc: The camera detects a second person in view. It also notices when the student looks away or switches windows. Grading happens on the server so correct answers never reach the student.

features.title: A separate environment for each institution
features.desc: The data of each institution is fully separated from the others at the database level. This covers its teachers and students too.

features.title: Invitation only
features.desc: Nobody enters the platform without an invitation. The institution invites its teachers and each teacher invites students to a group. Invitation links expire on their own.

features.title: Instant grades and reports
features.desc: Exams are graded as soon as they are submitted and grades are published with one click. Institution managers get full reports.

features.title: Organized lessons and groups
features.desc: Teachers place students in groups and publish lessons to each group. A student sees only the content of their own group.

featuresPage.rolesDesc: Every user sees only what belongs to them in an interface built for their work.

body: Account data such as your name and email address. We also keep your role and the institution you belong to.
Educational content created on the platform. This means lessons and exams together with answers and grades.
Monitoring data from monitored exams only. These are events such as switching windows or more than one face in front of the camera.
The camera image is analyzed on the student’s own device. We do not record or keep video.
After a serious violation we keep one still image for the course teacher to review. We keep no more than ten such images per student in each exam.
During live monitoring the video reaches the teacher only while the exam is running. This stream is not recorded.
We use it to run the platform. That means showing lessons and grading exams. It also means publishing grades and sending invitations.
We use monitoring events to protect the integrity of exams. They are reviewed by the course teacher.
We never sell your data or share it with anyone for marketing.
The data of each institution is separated from the others at the database level. No user can see the data of another institution.
Students see only the content of their own group. Teachers see only their own groups.
Data is hosted with Supabase on AWS servers in Frankfurt and with Vercel. It is encrypted in transit and at rest.
Administrative access is limited to the platform owner. Sensitive operations run on the server and never in the browser.
You can ask for your data to be corrected or your account to be deleted. Contact your institution admin or write to us directly.
When an institution is removed from the platform the data of its users is deleted.
For any privacy question use the Contact page.
Using EduQuest means you agree to these terms. If you do not agree do not use the platform.
Access is by invitation only. You are responsible for keeping your login details private and for everything done with your account.
Do not share your account or an invitation link with anyone other than the intended person.
The platform is for educational use only.
Cheating in exams or trying to get around monitoring is not allowed. Uploading illegal or abusive content is not allowed either.
Any attempt to break into the platform or reach the data of other institutions or users is not allowed.
Educational content created by teachers belongs to their institutions.
Content prepared with AI is a helping tool. The teacher is responsible for reviewing and approving it before publishing.
Institutions subscribe through a direct agreement with the platform management.
The platform may suspend any account that breaks these terms. Institution admins may suspend the accounts of their own users.
We work to keep the platform available and secure. We provide it as it is without a full guarantee that it will never be interrupted.
We may update these terms. We will announce any important change inside the platform.
For any question about these terms use the Contact page.
